fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' infects the target enemy's mind, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''. ''Malefic Visions'' executes {{tip|minions}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|10 to 30 for 11}} health}}}}.
fields.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 220}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 220/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/16}}% AP)}}}}
fields.description2: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|2% of his '''maximum''' mana}}}}.
